cost_centers_budget_complete.name: cost_centers_budget_complete
cost_centers_budget_complete.value: ("cost_centers"."budget_amount" IS NULL AND "cost_centers"."budget_currency" IS NULL AND "cost_centers"."budget_period" IS NULL AND "cost_centers"."budget_behaviour" IS NULL) OR ("cost_centers"."budget_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "cost_centers"."budget_currency" IS NOT NULL AND "cost_centers"."budget_period" IS NOT NULL AND "cost_centers"."budget_behaviour" IS NOT NULL)

infrastructure_elements_due_decommission.name: infrastructure_elements_due_decommission_idx
infrastructure_elements_due_decommission.where: scheduled_decommission_at IS NOT NULL AND status = 'active'

integrations_credential_check.name: integrations_credential_check
integrations_credential_check.value: auth_type = 'none' OR credential IS NOT NULL

orders_scheduled_consistency.name: orders_scheduled_consistency
orders_scheduled_consistency.value:
("orders"."scheduled_for" IS NULL OR "orders"."status" IN ('scheduled', 'provisioning', 'completed', 'failed'))
        AND ("orders"."window_override_by" IS NULL) = ("orders"."window_override_at" IS NULL)
